Septerra Core is an ATB-based RPG and can be considered the western equal of Final Fantasy VII. However, once you moved shell, the game become "Where the heck do I go next" kind of game that pits you against nearly moon-logic on how to trigger the next story event. There's a part that you need to makeshift a boat to cross a lake while you have a ship, or needing laser and not use Runner, your member whose entire repertoire of attacks are laser-based.

If you are brave enough to explore the 7 shells of Septerra Core, prepare for giant amount of tedium.

Patches

  • An unofficial patch by M-HT will make the game run better and allow windowed mode
  • Ensure to set DPI settings to Application in a high DPI environment.
  • Use Magpie to upscale the game from 640x480

Unofficial patch by M-HT on Github

Magpie on Github

Cheats

  • Press F12 and type in IMAREALWEENIE
    • In battle you can press Ctrl + F3 for instant win.
      • Battles are massive time sinks, save yourself.
    • Press F12 and type in ENEMIES to show enemy HP and turn gauge. Type again to disable it.
  • Press F12 and type in MAPMAKER to save an image of the entire map as BMP to the installation folder.
  • Press F12 and type in MAKETHEMSTOPMOMMIE to disable enemy encounter, but this includes bosses, so use with care, and a lot of backup saves. RType it again to disable it.
  • EXP Cheats, but tread carefully
    • Save before attempting
    • Press F12 and type in WTFWWT-BGIOB
    • Press F2 to gain 2300 EXP
    • Warning! Pressing F3 will cause Grub and Runner to be added to your party, and can break the game!
    • Restart game to turn off the cheat
  • You can use Cheat Engine to speedup the game.
The MAPMAKER cheat is important as this guide will refer to map internal names such as "Go to Mourn Graveyard LC316". It will help you navigate, especially in later areas as they are 100 screens big.
The game has a distinction between talk about certain item and use certain item on people. This guide specifically note each distinct thing to do with certain item in order to progress. If something was missed, I apologize.

The Emperor

  • Go to Chosen Capitol
    • Go to West District
      • Get Red Capitol Key
    • Go to East District
      • Use the Red Capitol Key on the console with the red monitor
      • Get Tank Engine
    • Go to Central District
      • Use Tank Engine on the broken tank
  • Arrive at the Palace, this is Main Hall LA104
    • Go to the left door to Left Wing LA101
      • Get the Blue Palace Key
    • Use Blue Palace Key on pedestal with blue orb on Main Hall
    • Go to Main Hall 2F LA102
      • There are three switches you need to flip and go though the door they opened.
        • Once you flip the third switch, flip the first switch
      • The boss is invulnerable
        • Hit the light ball he spawns with 1 gauge attack until it hits him.
        • Get Red Palace Key
        • You can now Summon marduk with Summon + Law
    • Go to Left Wing LA101
      • Use the Red Palace Key on the pedestal with red orb near where you find the Blue palace Key
      • Have some area attack since the boss can summon three spheres that you need to kill almost simultaneously or they will resurrect each other.
  • Go to Main Hall LA104
    • Use the Yellow Palace Key on the pedestal with yellow orb
  • Go to B1 LA103
    • There are 4 switches: one in left path, one in right path, and the rest is on the opened door.
    • The boss puts up barrier. Defeat the tspheres first.
    • Get Green Palace Key
  • Go to Main Hall LA104
    • Use the Green Palace Key on the pedestal with green orb
  • Go to Throne Room
    • The bosses somehow hurt each other.
      • Start by using 1 gauge attack on red to kill Green, then 1 gauge attack on yellow to kill red, then kill yellow.

Babylon

  • All elemental bosses hits hard. Use element Guard accessories equip Element-Barrier-AffectAll to mitigate damage. Their Charged attack is otherwise, fatal.
  • Go to Water Temple LH420
    • Switch 1 is near-bottom-left lower-ground
    • Switch 2 is on the bottom-right higher-ground
    • Get Temple Key
  • Go to Earth Temple LH421
    • Switch 1 is near top-left lower-ground
    • Switch 2 is near middle-top, on the biggert higher-ground
    • Switch 3 is on the bottom-right
    • Switch 4 and 5 is on the left and right of the double doors, lower-ground
    • Get Temple Key
  • Go to Air Temple LH422
    • Switch 1 is near top-right lower-ground, this opens Door 1
    • Switch 2 is at the down-left of Door 1, at the end of corridor, lower ground
    • Switch 3 is on the end of left path after climbing the stairs on the left of Door 1
    • Switch 4 is on the end of right path after climbing the stairs on the left of Door 1
    • Get Temple Key
      • Use Switch 4 to exit
  • Go to Fire Temple LH424
    • Bird #10: Give Bird Seed to a bird to a red purple bird after you first decend a set of stairs.
    • Switch 1 is near top-right lower-ground, this opens Door 1 and closes Door 2
  • Switch 2 is to the bottom right of the bird, or down from switch 1 in a sorta room, lower-ground
    • Switch 3 is on the end of path after Door 1, higher-ground
    • Switch 4 is on the end of path after Switch 3, lower-ground, this opens Door 3
    • Use Switch 3 to go to Door 3
    • Get Temple Key
    • Go to Marduk's Tample LH415
    • Use 4x Temple Key
    • Combine Chosen Seal with Imperial Seal
      • Get Talisman Seal
    • Use Talisman Seal on the red door
      • Get DaemonSword
      • Get DaemonSword
      • These are treated as different weapons.

Intermission Part 4

Shell 3

  • Go to the ??? Tower LX004, top-right of Wind City.
    • With all 10 birds fed, the door will open when checked.
    • The pathing is wonky, so use arrow buttons to move if you can't enter via mouse movement.
    • There are 3 treasure rooms to loot.

The Last Part

  • Equipment check: DaemonSwords, and everyone should be using their best equipment
  • Talk to Layla

Shell 2

  • Make one final save
  • Go to Chosen Battleship, this is the point of no return
    • Grubb's Path LA212
      • Get Red FS Key from the big robot after you flip the Switch 5 on LA211
        • This enemy must see you, so turn off MAKETHEMSTOPMOMMIE
        • The enemy can cloak loop. prepare to use Ctrl + F3.
      • Use the Red FS Key to enter LA214
        • Get Blue FS Key
    • Lobo's Path LA212
      • Use Blue FS Key enter LA213
        • Get Yellow FS Key
      • Use the Yellow FS Key to enter LA215
    • Maya's Path LA212
      • Save a different save, and go to the end of the hall.
      • Penultimate Boss can summon an undead minion with exactly 1000 HP. Use 2x Cornucopia to kill them
      • Penultimate Boss can summonn a barrier. A Summmon Marduk on the Barrier will kill it. Remember, target the barrier.
      • Last Boss requires Barrier-AffectAll at least. Speed-All and Cloak-All will also help
      • Last Boss can clone himself. Use any attack-all attack to remove them, but he will immediately cast an attack that can do 300+ damage even when barriered. Cloak can make this attack miss almost all the time.
  • The End
